articles.title: Mass Exodus from the ICC: Chad Becomes Fifth Nation to Quit Amid US Pressure and Bias Claims
articles.summary: Chad is the latest country to withdraw from the International Criminal Court, following four African neighbors and Venezuela. The withdrawals come amid intense US hostility after the ICC issued arrest warrants for Israeli leaders. Critics say the court is losing its legitimacy, while supporters warn of a crisis for international justice.

articles.title: Jodrell Bank's Iconic Telescope Faces the Axe: Scientists Decry 'Heartbreaking' Cuts
articles.summary: The UK's Jodrell Bank Observatory, a UNESCO World Heritage site and Cold War relic, will cease scientific observations in 2028 due to funding cuts. The decision imperils 28 jobs and research for 3,000 scientists. Professor Brian Cox calls it "hasty and ill-considered," as the iconic Lovell Telescope faces an uncertain future.

articles.title: UNESCO's Double-Edged Sword: Can a Heritage Listing Save Sebastia?
articles.summary: UNESCO has placed the 3,000-year-old site of Sebastia on both its World Heritage and Danger lists, citing Israeli land confiscation plans. Palestinians celebrate, but Israel calls it a political move. History shows listings alone rarely halt settlement expansion.
